name: purple-voice
description: Purple Voice — AI voice agents for sales calls. Public website, subscriber dashboard, admin panel and real-time voice infrastructure.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pv/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:shared dev:api dev:worker dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pv/shared && npm run build -w @pv/api && npm run build -w @pv/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pv/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
